items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Me and Terry (?), we came...in '54 we came to New Orleans

ctx.x: Finish talking, Lu, while I get tuned up here. Me and Terry (?), we came...in '54 we came to New Orleans -- about '54. It was '48 when we came down here, you know... No, we were in California. And Danny had written a tune called "This Little Girl From Jacksonville." So the tune was a hit in Louisiana and Texas. So Paul wrote us, and said, "Why don't you all come down here, because the tune is a hit." So we could tour Louisiana and Texas...
